solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: One additional composite triangle formed by combining smaller ones → 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77b4873f0861897c718baaa56f1e61bdca6eee6e31e2953c494f325dd4d0dce5.png] 

Thus, 4 (small)+4 (medium)+3 (large)=**11​**​

Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.
